title: THE SOVEREIGN GUARDS THE DOOR — NOT THE DESIRE
semantic_thesis: The first face does not remain king of future faces. Its lasting role is to seed a constitutional threshold that protects the conditions under which later desires may become actions.

ru: Первое лицо оставляет не трон, а порог.
Суверен не выбирает любимое будущее; он охраняет условия, при которых будущее получает право войти в мир.
Если два желания допустимы, Судья обязан уметь сказать: закон не выбрал победителя.
en: The first face leaves a threshold, not a throne.
The sovereign does not choose a favorite future; it guards the conditions under which a future may enter the world.
If two desires are admissible, the judge must be able to say: the constitution chose no winner.

boundary: Semantic systems interpretation only; no claim of machine personhood, consciousness or legal sovereignty.
